# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Use Contextro MCP as the default discovery layer for unfamiliar or multi-file code work.

- Run `status()` first and `index()` only when the repository is not indexed yet.
- Use `search()` before broad file reads.
- Prefer `find_symbol()`, `explain()`, `find_callers()`, and `find_callees()` over grep for symbol discovery.
- Use `impact()` before renaming, deleting, or changing public signatures.
- Use `overview()` or `architecture()` for first-pass repo orientation.
- Read full files only after Contextro has narrowed the scope.

See `docs/contextro-agent-guide.md` for the longer workflow reference when it is present.
